staticRegistry.rule: Only literal/const-resolved official registrations enter this 22-app set. Dynamic community plugin-view definitions are verified in their own family and are never merged into the official golden.

apps.close: close panel without cancelling domain/background task

acceptance.expected: reopen same identity activates existing panel; other allowed identity follows instanceMode
resource and domain task state preserved; transient launch payload is not restored

owner.source: contributing community plugin id from the views slot entry
owner.panelAuthority: appRegistry definition owner is the mirrored family; view-level plugin scope remains entry.owner
owner.replacement: same viewKey with a different owner/value unregisters the old definition before registering the replacement

singleton.scope: one window per plugin-view.<viewKey> typeId; distinct community views may coexist

resourceIdentity.owner: slot provenance and rendering scope; not an extra panel dimension
resourceIdentity.resourceKey: the keyed views slot guarantees one live contribution per viewKey; a viewKey is a community view identity, not an official ResourceType

reconciliation.unchanged: same entry.value identity and owner → no registry churn
reconciliation.update: owner/value change for the same viewKey → unregister old then register new
reconciliation.remove: slot entry removal → appRegistry.unregister(typeId, mirroredDefinition), leaving unrelated definitions untouched
reconciliation.stop: unsubscribe views and unregister every mirrored definition; later slot changes do not resurrect apps

draft.panelState: plugin content and plugin storage own view state; the shell owns only window layout
draft.close: requestClose uses the shell default because the mirrored definition has no app-specific close guard

snapshot.restore: the shell may restore the layout entry by typeId before the plugin provider exists; WindowBody then takes the appRegistry miss branch (data-wb-unknown-app / unknownApp copy) and does not mount PluginViewAppWindow. The missing-view notice belongs to PluginViewAppWindow after a registered app loses its slot entry.

missingProvider.condition: no live mirrored appDefinition for the restored typeId
missingProvider.renders: WindowBody data-wb-unknown-app with workbench:window.unknownApp; PluginViewAppWindow is not mounted

missingViewAfterUnmount.condition: PluginViewAppWindow is already mounted and the registered app remains, while its views slot entry is revoked

snapshot.draft: not stored by the workbench snapshot; plugin data must use plugin-owned portable/local storage

back.panel: close returns to the prior shell focus stack; no mirrored app-specific back stack
back.view: internal navigation remains the plugin view host responsibility

nativeDelivery.responsibility: dynamic plugin view rendering, owner scope, slot/view/lifecycle removal
formal workbench panel host, layout, focus and close integration
per-package installation/run/update/revoke evidence, including official UI contribution coverage

acceptance.expected: community views register plugin-view.<viewKey> with single instance mode and plugin name scope
builtin views never enter the dynamic family
owner/value replacement swaps the definition without changing the typeId mapping
slot removal unregisters only the mirrored definition
re-adding the entry restores the same typeId and a fresh definition
layout snapshot keeps typeId; component/draft/payload are not persisted

stubs.boundary: Only render-only imports are substituted; registration, reconciliation, lookup, slot storage and app registry are production code.

exclusions.reason: definition exists but registerAll intentionally routes mindmaps through notes
virtual Agent target; not a registered UI app
dynamic community family; not an official static app and not part of apps.json golden

resourceKey.panelIdentity: appId + instanceKey; resourceKey remains distinct from panel id
resourceKey.local: layout, draft, view state and running task ownership

launchPlacement.defaultAnchor: focused window when anchorWindowId is absent
launchPlacement.newWindow: plan and place the new window beside the source without covering it when feasible; may tile or minimally move the source according to the source layout and available space
launchPlacement.existingWindow: focus the existing identity only; never move the existing window and never change the source window mode
launchPlacement.dropPointPrecedence: dropPoint takes precedence over beside placement

stubs.boundary: Only unrelated agent, notes/content workspace and close-guard imports are substituted; launch placement, window store, tiling and app registry are production code.
